_comment: REPO-ROOT-tier crate/module decomposition for libxml2 v2.15.3.
SEEDED SHELL - `modules` is empty on purpose; Phase 2 homes each wave lazily.
The member lists are an enumeration of the entity inventory, which does
not exist until `extract-ql` has produced the T1 tables; authoring them
ahead of the database would be guessing at names. The crate identity,
paths and link edges below ARE settled and do not depend on it.
One link unit, so one crate. `depends_on` mirrors build.json's
`link_dependencies` for libxml2 exactly - the placement oracle keys on
the same library names bindgen uses.

_comment_modules: Fill during Phase 1, after `extract-ql`.
A wrap-only target homes its entities by IMPORT HEADER, not by
translation unit: the orchestrator routes a wrap item through its
the oracle API declaration inventory, so the module tree should mirror
include/libxml/ rather than the 55 flat .c files. Expect roughly one
module per public header, with `tu: null` on every `.rs` - nothing
here is ported, so no module mirrors a C translation unit.
Suggested grouping, by the subsystem boundaries the headers already
draw (sizes are XMLPUBFUN counts at this tag):
tree      tree.h 172, entities.h, valid.h 71
parser    parser.h 126, parserInternals.h 75, SAX2.h 36, HTMLparser.h 43
xpath     xpath.h 41, xpathInternals.h 117, xpointer.h, pattern.h
io        xmlIO.h 55, encoding.h, xmlsave.h, xmlwriter.h 81
reader    xmlreader.h 89
schema    xmlschemas.h, xmlschemastypes.h 34, relaxng.h, schematron.h
util      xmlstring.h 30, hash.h, list.h, dict.h, uri.h, buf.h
catalog   catalog.h 37
Verify against the real inventory before committing to it - the
authority is `crustify-oracle /work/libxml2 . query types --imported-only`
and the symbol equivalent, not this comment.
